syncMode.description:
How the watcher reacts to local file edits.
- 'auto'   (default): push changes within the debounce window; periodic full sync.
- 'manual': watcher only runs periodic pulls; pushes are user-driven via Sync Now /   Push to Ghost. Lets cautious users avoid surprise writes to their blog.

contentKinds.description: Which content kinds this target syncs, in BOTH directions. Empty = sync nothing. Pull lists only these kinds; push skips local files whose `cms_kind` is not in this list. Nothing is enabled implicitly — a kind only syncs once the user opts into it (e.g. `['post']`, `['post','page']`, Shopify `['article','product']`).

vaultPath.description: Absolute path to the vault root.

watchDebounceMs.description: Debounce window (ms) for the file watcher before flushing changes.

oauthBaseUrl.description:
Origin of the OAuth broker the desktop shells use to run hosted OAuth flows (start → callback → token exchange). Read ONLY by the shells, never by the daemon — the daemon consumes the resulting token like any other.

PRO ships pointing at the hosted broker (`https://spectersync.com`) so OAuth is turnkey. DIY users who want OAuth must register their own provider app and stand up their own broker, then set this to its origin; absent, the shells fall back to the hosted default. Optional so existing configs and pasted-token users need no migration.

targets.description: Multi-target list. Always present after `loadConfig()` (synthesized from legacy fields if absent on disk). Always written to disk by `saveConfig`.

vaultLayout.description: Vault folder layout marker. `'namespaced'` means every target's files already live under its handle folder (the only layout written since v0.6). Absent (or `'flat'`) marks a pre-v0.6 config whose single target may still have files at the bare `syncFolderPath` — `migrateVaultLayout` checks and relocates them once, then stamps `'namespaced'`. Optional so existing on-disk configs load unchanged and trigger exactly one migration pass.

handle.description: URL-safe handle — also the folder name when multiple targets are configured.

syncFolderPath.description: Subfolder under the target's effective root. Empty means the effective root itself is used. In single-target configs, this collapses to the legacy `syncFolderPath` behavior.

contentKinds.description: Which content kinds this target syncs (both directions). Opt-in: nothing syncs unless listed. Pull lists only these kinds; push skips local files whose `cms_kind` is not enabled. Legacy configs (no field) migrate to the platform's base post kind on load so existing post sync is preserved.

TargetConfig.description:
Per-target configuration: one CMS connection + the engine-visible sync settings that govern how its content lives in the vault.

v0.4.0 Phase B introduces this as the canonical unit; legacy single-Ghost configs (every shipped user) auto-synthesize a single `targets[0]` on load via `synthesizeLegacyTarget`. The writer still emits the legacy flat fields alongside `targets[]` for one release window so a downgrade is non-fatal.

accessToken.description: Admin API access token (shpat_… for dev-store, OAuth token in prod).

refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token for expiring offline tokens. Rotated after every refresh.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the access token expires.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when the refresh token expires.

apiVersion.description: GraphQL API version. Defaults to the adapter's pinned version.

siteUrl.description: Full URL of the WordPress site, e.g. "https://myblog.com".

siteId.description: Webflow site ID whose CMS collections are synced.

apiToken.description: Site API token (Bearer) — the AGPL/DIY auth path. Paste a token from the site's API access settings.

accessToken.description: OAuth access token (PRO). Issued by the hosted OAuth flow (`web/src/pages/api/oauth/webflow/`). Webflow OAuth tokens are long-lived and non-expiring with no refresh token, so this is simply another bearer token — used in preference to `apiToken`. The adapter never branches on which produced the token. At least one of `apiToken` / `accessToken` must be present.

fieldMap.description: Optional per-collection field-mapping overrides, keyed by collection id. Omitted fields fall back to auto-detection (name → title, slug → slug, first RichText field → body).

AdapterConfig.description: Per-platform credential block. Discriminated by `platform`. Other config (vault path, sync folder, conflict strategy, …) stays in the top-level DaemonConfig — these fields are purely the CMS connection.
